title: Let's build a Chatbot - Repo + Aspire Solution (Part 1)

cues.en: Hi. In this video, I'm going to talk a little about how we are going to build our chatbot.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支影片會稍微介紹，我們要如何建置聊天機器人。

cues.en: Not the code itself, but more how we are going to store it in a repository up in GitHub, and how the solution is set up. So...
cues.zh: 不是程式碼本身，而是如何存放在 GitHub 儲存庫，以及方案如何設定。

cues.en: For this, I've made a free and open source repo up on GitHub.
cues.zh: 為此，我建立了一個免費、開放原始碼的 GitHub 儲存庫。

cues.en: You can grab it at this link, or scan this QR code in order to get to it.
cues.zh: 可以透過這個連結，或掃描 QR Code 前往。

cues.en: And in there, there will be issues.
cues.zh: 儲存庫中會有 Issues。

cues.en: Here's some of the things I've already put up that I want to include in this series.
cues.zh: 這裡是我已經列出、想加入系列的功能。

cues.en: So often, it will be that I will implement one of these issues, and it will end up being a video about the system.
cues.zh: 因此我通常會實作其中一個 Issue，再製作成一支介紹影片。

cues.en: In terms of what you get if you go and grab the repo, for now, it is only a Blazor server,
cues.zh: 如果現在下載儲存庫，目前只會看到 Blazor Server，

cues.en: but later on, there will be multiple folders here with various different things for the various frontends and backends as we go along.
cues.zh: 不過隨著系列進展，會加入更多資料夾，包含不同前端與後端。

cues.en: But as it's a Blazor server here in this, there's only this one that takes care of it.
cues.zh: 目前是 Blazor Server，因此只有這個專案負責主要功能。

cues.en: But because we will have multiple frontends and multiple backends, I put this into .NET Aspire.
cues.zh: 但因為未來會有多種前端與後端，所以我使用 .NET Aspire。

cues.en: So we have an app host, and we have the normal surface default, so we can host the things.
cues.zh: 有 AppHost，也有一般的 ServiceDefaults，方便託管各項服務。

cues.en: And we're actually going to use them actively.
cues.zh: 我們也會實際運用這些功能。

cues.en: So we could have put everything up in Blazor server and just have that one.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以全部放進 Blazor Server，只保留那個專案。

cues.en: But what I'm doing is, in app host, I'm asking for the various parameters.
cues.zh: 但這裡會在 AppHost 中，取得各種參數。

cues.en: So for Azure OpenAI endpoints and keys and so on.
cues.zh: 例如 Azure OpenAI 端點、金鑰等等。

cues.en: So if you are going along, you need to get the various keys.
cues.zh: 因此如果跟著實作，需要取得各項金鑰。

cues.en: If that's a problem, sound off in the comments.
cues.zh: 如果有困難，可以在留言中告訴我。

cues.en: I will find a way to make it so we don't need every single one of them if need be.
cues.zh: 有需要的話，我會找方法，讓大家不必準備全部金鑰。

cues.en: But then we're going to set up the various projects.
cues.zh: 接著設定各個專案。

cues.en: In this case, we're setting up the Blazor server only project here as normal Aspire setup.
cues.zh: 目前只有 Blazor Server Only，以一般 Aspire 方式設定。

cues.en: And then in service defaults, we are doing the baseline things that all the different backends are going to use.
cues.zh: ServiceDefaults 則處理所有後端都會用到的共用基礎設定。

cues.en: So we're using the agent framework through my toolkit that I have, so we can spin up an agent factory.
cues.zh: 例如透過我的 Toolkit 使用 Agent Framework，建立 Agent Factory。

cues.en: And so everything in the dependency injection that needs to go across the backend,
cues.zh: 因此，後端之間需要共用的相依性注入設定，

cues.en: that needs to go across the various different backends that we're going to build.
cues.zh: 也就是未來建立的不同後端都需要的內容，都放在這裡。

cues.en: We'll probably build at least two, the Blazor server itself and a minimal API backend for the various other frontends.
cues.zh: 至少應該會有兩種後端：Blazor Server 本身，以及供其他前端使用的 Minimal API。

cues.en: So we're keeping it here so it's easy for us to keep it centralized like Aspire is meant to be.
cues.zh: 因此集中放在這裡，就能符合 Aspire 的用途，方便統一管理。

cues.en: So we're setting up the agent framework initialization here, and we're setting up the open weather map because we're going to use some tools from open weather map
cues.zh: 這裡初始化 Agent Framework，也設定 OpenWeatherMap，因為接下來會使用它的一些工具，

cues.en: as our test tools as we go along.
cues.zh: 作為測試工具。

cues.en: More things might come here as the various different backends need to have them shared.
cues.zh: 隨著各個後端需要共用更多設定，這裡也可能加入其他內容。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, when you run it for the first time at this recording, there will only be one resource.
cues.zh: 在這次錄影的時間點，第一次執行時，只會有一個 Resource。

cues.en: That would be the Blazor server.
cues.zh: 也就是 Blazor Server。

cues.en: But later on in the series, more and more will come here.
cues.zh: 但隨著系列進展，這裡會有更多資源。

cues.en: And over in the resources, you also have the parameters, so you can switch to the parameter list and key in your features.
cues.zh: 在 Resources 中也能看到 Parameters，可以切換參數清單，輸入自己的設定。

cues.en: If you don't have them put in, it will show a little button, say enter missing values, and you can put them in.
cues.zh: 如果尚未填入，會有 Enter Missing Values 按鈕，可以在那裡補上。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, they're just stored in user sequence like normal.
cues.zh: 背後只是像平常一樣，存放在 User Secrets。

cues.en: So now I think we're ready to move on to the first baseline, which is our Blazor server.
cues.zh: 現在應該準備好進入第一個基本版本，也就是 Blazor Server。
